title: fq-policy/2 — the recipe
description: What a consumer asks for: one bit-width per expert per MoE layer. This single document drives both halves of the pipeline — fq_fetch turns it into the byte ranges to download, fq_assemble turns it into a checkpoint. bits_per_expert maps a decimal layer number (as a string) to a DENSE list of K values, one per expert, indexed by expert id; layers absent from the map are passed through unchanged by fq_assemble (dense/attention layers). The optional budget and manifest blocks record how the recipe was produced and which segment tree it was solved against; nothing consumes them at assembly time. Derived from the recipes in ~/fq-0c (policy-all-k3.json, policy-fruit-mixed-042.json).

additionalProperties.description: K per expert, indexed by expert id; length must equal the layer's expert count

manifest.description: digest of the fq-manifest.json this recipe was solved against, when it was solved against one

budget.description: how the allocation was chosen — provenance for the recipe itself
